$comment: Everything that expires, in one list. scripts/renewals.mjs reads it and .github/workflows/renewals.yml posts warnings to the #renewals channel (docs/ci-cd.md, section 5). Each item has either expires (YYYY-MM-DD, or null with a note when the date is unknown) or check (read live: tls, rdap, securitytxt). Only dates from the docs; never guess one.

items.name: Certum code-signing certificate (Windows)
items.renew: Order the renewal in the Certum shop (same identity), verify, activate in SimplySign; same CN keeps auto-update working

items.name: Apple Developer ID Application certificate
items.renew: New key + CSR, Developer ID Application (G2) certificate, p12, then gh secret set MAC_CERT_P12_BASE64 and MAC_CERT_PASSWORD

items.name: Apple Developer Program membership
items.renew: Auto-renew is on (999 kr/year): check the card at developer.apple.com → Membership details before the date, or Mac builds stop being notarized

items.name: DigitalOcean token DO_MARKETPLACE_TOKEN (90 days, from 2026-10-15)
items.renew: New 90-day token with the scopes in marketplace/digitalocean/README.md, then gh secret set DO_MARKETPLACE_TOKEN --env marketplace

items.name: Android release keystore
items.note: date unknown: owner to fill (docs say ~27 years, ~2053; the exact date is in keytool -list -v -keystore iskra-android.keystore)
items.renew: Can't be renewed: enrol in Play App Signing long before, so Google holds the app key

items.name: iskra.foo domain registration
items.renew: Check auto-renew (and the card) at the registrar (Porkbun), or renew by hand

items.name: security.txt Expires on iskra.foo (site/.well-known/security.txt)
items.renew: Move Expires a year ahead in both security.txt files (at most a year), check Contact and Policy, deploy site and web app

items.name: security.txt Expires on app.iskra.foo (client/public/.well-known/security.txt)
items.renew: Move Expires a year ahead in both security.txt files (at most a year), check Contact and Policy, deploy site and web app

items.name: TLS certificate of iskra.foo
items.renew: Cloudflare Pages renews it itself; if it doesn't, check the custom domain in the Pages project

items.name: TLS certificate of app.iskra.foo
items.renew: Cloudflare Pages renews it itself; if it doesn't, check the custom domain in the Pages project

items.name: TLS certificate of chat.iskra.foo
items.renew: The server renews it itself (Let's Encrypt); port 80 must stay open. Check the server log
